violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. - OBSERVED: a food employee washed hand in prep sink before preparing ready to eat food.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. - CORRECTIVE: EHS educated the food employee. Employee washed hands properly in hand sink.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: cooked shrimp (102f), cooked broccoli (132f), and cooked brisket (124f) were stored in steam table for about 1 hour.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM would like to apply TPHC the abovementioned food items. Food will be discarded within 3 hours.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: - OBSERVED: kiwi coconut (38f) was prepared on 7/23/2026. By the time of inspection, it has been stored in walk-in cooler for more than 7 days.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the food item.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: - OBSERVED: sushi rice was not labeled with 4 hour end point.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated the CFMs and prompted the CFMs to label sushi rice with 4 hour end point.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: all food items which are under cooked or contain raw ingredients.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please add a proper consumer advisory to the menu for all the food items which are under cooked or contain raw ingredients. LEI'D POKE (Inspection Date: 08/03/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.observation: OBSERVED: sewage backuping from the grease trap and/or the draining pipe under 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: manager placed a work order immediately.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. OBSERVED HOT WATER TEMPERATURE AT HAND SINK AT 74F
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: TUNA (46F) AND SALMON (45F) WERE STORED IN TURBO-AIR 2-DOR PREP COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: MASAGO, SALMON AND TUNA.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. MANAGER REVISED THE MENU IMMEDIATELY.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: DICED TUNA WAS THAWING IN INTACT PACKAGES IN WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: EHS EDUCATED THE CFM. CFM MADE A CUT IN EACH PACKAGE OF THE FROZEN TUNA.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF SESAME SAUCE, EEL SAUCE, WASABI SAUCE, AND SRIRACHA SAUCE AT SERVICE LINE WERE NOT LABELED.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM LABELED THE SQUEEZE BOTTLES IMMEDIATELY.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: (1) SCOOP FOR PASTA SALAD WAS STORED IN THE CONTAINER OF THE FOOD WITH ITS HANDLE IN CONTACT OF FOOD. (2) A TONG WAS STORED IN SOBA NOODLES WITH ITS HANDLE IN TOUCH OF FOOD.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS SENT THE UTENSILS TO WASH.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: M3 2-DOOR COOLER AND EXPO SERVICE COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THESE TWO COOLERS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED INFORMATION OF THE APPROVED SPLITTER WITH CFM. CFM WILL NEED TO INSTALL AN APPROVED SPLITTER WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.
